comparison.objective: Load four modules into a hinged frame and close it until it clicks; candidate depins a single terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated module placement followed by bimanual frame closure versus constrained extraction-tool insertion and coordinated release/pull.
comparison.success_condition: Requires four modules seated and the frame latched; candidate requires one designated terminal removed while neighbors and housing remain retained and reusable. Candidate force limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Module loading and frame latching test assembly, not selective internal terminal release.
